ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a two-port network. The left port voltage is labeled V1, with the upper end positive and the lower end negative; the left port current I1 flows into the network from the upper left port toward the right. The right port voltage is labeled V2, with the upper end positive and the lower end negative; the right port current I2 flows into the network from the upper right port toward the left. A 10 Ω resistor is connected in series between the upper left port and the right port; at the node at the right end of the 10 Ω resistor, a 20 Ω resistor is connected downward to the bottom common wire. The upper end of the right port is directly connected to the junction of the 10 Ω and 20 Ω resistors, so the voltage of this node is V2. Reasoning: The h-parameter definitions are V1 = h11 I1 + h12 V2, I2 = h21 I1 + h22 V2. Applying Ohm's law to the 10 Ω series resistor, current I1 flows through this resistor from left to right, so I1 = (V1 - V2)/10, therefore V1 = 10 I1 + V2. From this h11 = 10, h12 = 1. Then write KCL at the V2 node: the current reaching the node from the left through 10 Ω is I1, and the current entering the node from the right port is I2; after the two flow in, they flow downward out through the 20 Ω resistor, so I1 + I2 = V2/20. Rearranging gives I2 = -I1 + 0.05 V2, so h21 = -1, h22 = 0.05. Thus the h-parameter matrix is [[10, 1], [-1, 0.05]].

method.method_draft: First identify the output top node voltage as V2 because the right positive terminal is directly connected to the junction of the 10 Ω and 20 Ω resistors. Apply Ohm’s law to the 10 Ω series resistor with I1 flowing left-to-right: I1=(V1−V2)/10, hence V1=10I1+V2, giving h11=10 and h12=1. Then apply KCL at the V2 node: the shunt current through 20 Ω is V2/20 and is supplied by the currents arriving from the left branch and the right port, so I1+I2=V2/20. Rearranging gives I2=−I1+0.05V2, so h21=−1 and h22=0.05. Assemble the matrix.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个二端口网络。左端口电压标为 V1，上端为正，下端为负；左端口电流 I1 从左侧上端口向右流入网络。右端口电压标为 V2，上端为正，下端为负；右端口电流 I2 从右侧上端口向左流入网络。上方左端口与右端口之间串联一个 10 Ω 电阻；在 10 Ω 电阻右端的节点处，有一个 20 Ω 电阻向下连接到底部公共导线。右端口上端直接连接到 10 Ω 与 20 Ω 的 junction，因此该节点电压就是 V2。推理：h 参数定义为 V1 = h11 I1 + h12 V2，I2 = h21 I1 + h22 V2。对 10 Ω 串联电阻应用欧姆定律，电流 I1 从左到右流过该电阻，所以 I1 = (V1 - V2)/10，因此 V1 = 10 I1 + V2。由此 h11 = 10，h12 = 1。再在 V2 节点列 KCL：从左侧经 10 Ω 到达节点的电流为 I1，从右端口进入节点的电流为 I2，二者流入后经 20 Ω 电阻向下流出，故 I1 + I2 = V2/20。整理得 I2 = -I1 + 0.05 V2，所以 h21 = -1，h22 = 0.05。于是 h 参数矩阵为 [[10, 1], [-1, 0.05]]。
